Name: No Despawn Truffle Crab
Author: AstralFSK
Description:
Have you ever met a truffle crab, and tried to make friends with it ?
I gave it a house to stay, I raised it like my other animals, I liked it because it didn't attack me like other crabs, just to find out the next time I booted the game, it ghosted me. But with this mod, it can't do that to me no more.

Downloads.Description: Fix a very very rare case that make truffle crabs' number explode.

Manifest.Name: No Despawn Truffle Crab
Manifest.Description: Make Truffle Crabs not despawn when load game
Manifest.Author: Astral
